C03 ADVISOR FORBIDDEN (budget 0): do not call the `advisor` tool and do not spawn subagents or delegate. advisor_calls is a required return field and must be 0; a nonzero count is a contract breach and the status becomes NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

M01 Authoring contract: the coordinator loads the `plugin-authoring` skill at dispatch and passes you (a) the path of this build's claude-code.d.ts and (b) the reference notes. The declaration checked is Claude Code 2.1.304, sha256 652e8b9b5ad4d2d7b8936a46c760bf93ab20dc7b72f4334cf3f39dd0b6109385. M02 Pattern reference (read-only, `git show feat/pulse-001:plugins/dopemux-pulse/<file>`, else `origin/feat/pulse-001`; if neither resolves, STOP): helpers declared at the top of the file that take `$` and the state object as arguments, every hook body wrapped so no exception surfaces, `session.end` with reason 'clear' keeps running, `Promise.race` against `$.clock.after` for timeouts, command registration and `command.run`.

M03 Pulse audit lesson F1: a raced async call is not cancelled. Keep an in-flight flag per resource (the outbox write chain, the ledger subprocess) so a hung call cannot pile up overlapping calls; test with a 'slow' mock.

M04 Hook safety: observing hooks (tool.call, turn.start, turn.complete, session.compact) call `next(e)` and return its result unchanged: never deny, rewrite, delay or veto. No `prompt.submit` rewriting, no `$.model.*`, no `$.agent.*`, no `$.tool.register`, no `$.session.send`, no `$.session.append`, no `$.http.fetch` (this revision makes no HTTP call at all; tests assert it). The only slash command is the one W03 names.

M05 Home: plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/ with the layout of plugins/dopemux-pulse/ on feat/pulse-001: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, hooks/hooks.json (one module path), hooks/register.tsx, hooks/register.test.ts, README.md; types/index.d.ts only if `$.state` is used. Whether hooks.json may name more than one module is UNKNOWN (W01): use one module. Do not write under ~/.claude, do not enable hot reload, do not run `claude plugin install`.

M06 Surfaces: `$.process` is documented CLI-only; its behaviour on the operator's desktop surface is UNKNOWN. Everything that needs it (git status in the band, the ledger replay) must degrade without throwing, and the outbox plus status line must work without it. AbovePrompt exists on the terminal and desktop surfaces only. Tests cover with and without `$.process`.

M07 Verification: TDD (show the failing test before the code). Run `claude plugin validate plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge` and `claude plugin test plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge`; type-check with `tsc -p` if the types were laid. Report each as PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN with the reason. Live proof (a real session with the mod) is NOT_RUN by design: say what the operator must do to see it.

M08 Privacy: the outbox and any ledger event hold only derived fields (goal, relative file paths, marker-detected decisions, todo titles, the user's own note text), never raw prompts, tool output or the assistant's full answer. A deterministic in-mod redactor masks sk-/sk-ant-/ghp_/AKIA tokens, Bearer values, URL userinfo, email addresses, DATABASE_URL=/password=/token=/secret= pairs and PEM blocks (W01 Q11 found the repo's redactor misses sk-ant keys, URL userinfo, emails and DATABASE_URL=), and caps every string before it is written.

O01 Outbox location and write model are fixed by W01 (GATE_TABLE.decisions): one file per session id at `<repo-root>/.dopemux/memory-bridge/outbox-<sessionId>.jsonl`, written only when `<repo-root>/.dopemux` already exists (gitignored by .gitignore:140 and :299 in this repo; other repos UNKNOWN, so never create `.dopemux`); `<repo-root>` is found by the upward `.git`/`.dopemux` walk used in src/dopemux/memory/capture_client.py:76-87, not by `$.session.repo()`. When the directory is absent the outbox is in memory plus `$.store`, and the status line says so.

O02 Write model: a single writer per file, serialised through one in-module promise chain because `$.fs.write` replaces the whole file (no append, delete or rename); a rewrite-in-place ring capped at 1 MiB per file and 8 KB per row (read and write limit is 4 MiB); two alternating generation files for torn-write safety as W01 specifies. Over the cap drop the oldest 'sent' rows first, then the oldest 'pending', and count the drops. A write failure never surfaces; the status line shows it.

O03 Record schema v:1, one JSON object per line: { v, id (deterministic: sha256 of session_id + turn_id + kind, truncated), ts, kind ('turn'|'compact'|'end'|'task'|'note'), session_id, cwd_rel, goal, files_touched (unique relative paths, at most 30), decisions (marker-detected, at most 3), todos_completed (titles, at most 10), note (kind 'note' only), intended_event ('task.completed'|'manual.memory_store'|null), state ('pending'|'sent'|'dead'), attempts }. No raw prompt, tool output or answer text.

O04 Decision capture is marker-only and stays LOCAL: a line of `answer` starting `Decision:` or `DECISION:` (optionally bold) yields one decision, at most 3 per turn, 200 characters each, kept in the outbox for the band. `decision.logged` is NOT_BUILT and must never be emitted anywhere: repo doctrine says decisions are logged in ConPort only and ConPort already emits it (W01).

O05 Task completion capture: observe `tool.call` for TodoWrite and compare `todos[].status` with the previous list in the same loop; each item that newly becomes 'completed' adds a title to the turn's todos_completed and, once per item, a 'task' record with intended_event 'task.completed'. Subagent loops (agentId set) are ignored.

A01 PROPOSED allowances for this workstream (caps, not forecasts; the operator accepts them by authorizing R2): elapsed wall time 90 min from dispatch; subagent tokens 1,200,000; tool uses 250; child attempts: 1 attempt + 1 retry; team-lead review rounds: 1 diff re-read + at most 1 correction round. Active (model-working) time is not separately recordable by the harness: UNKNOWN; elapsed is the enforceable bound.

A02 The team lead reads the recordable counters from the child's completion notice (duration_ms, subagent_tokens, tool_uses) and records them with the return. A retry is allowed only after a failed validation with a named cause and only once; a second failure, any exceeded cap or any advisor call ends the workstream.

A03 When a cap is hit: stop the workstream, start no further attempt, preserve the uncommitted diff untouched, and return NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the counters and the evidence. No model upgrade, provider change or extra attempt without a new operator ruling.

L01 Scope (GATE_TABLE.replay.ledger_emit GO_REDUCED; dope_memory_store NO_GO): replay pending 'task' and 'note' rows to the LOCAL capture ledger only, through `$.process.run(["dopemux", "capture", "emit", "--event", <json>, "--mode", "plugin", "--repo-root", <repo-root>], { timeoutMs: 15000 })`. The event JSON shape, the stable event_id derivation and the accepted event types are exactly those W01_FINDINGS.md Q5 records from src/dopemux/memory/capture_client.py:455-596 and :316-345; do not invent keys. Allowed event types: task.completed and manual.memory_store. Start from the committed W02 head and edit only the allowlisted files.

L02 What the route is and is not (W01): CLI-only; idempotent through the stable event_id; writes raw_activity_events only (nothing local promotes them to work_log); needs services/working-memory-assistant under the repo root and fails closed elsewhere; costs about 2.8 s per call. Therefore: serialise calls (one at a time, M03 guard), at most 3 per tick, tick every 60 s only while rows are pending, mark a row 'sent' only on exit code 0, count attempts, and after 5 failed attempts mark it 'dead' (status `⚠ N undeliverable`) instead of retrying forever. A non-zero exit, a timeout or an unavailable `$.process` leaves the row pending and the status line shows `📮 N pending (ledger unavailable)`.

L03 Manual note: register one slash command `bridge-note` (description: 'Store a note in the capture ledger'; argumentHint '<text>') in `session.start` and answer it in `command.run`: redact and cap the text (500 characters), append a 'note' row with intended_event manual.memory_store, return `{ text }` saying it was queued (not that it was stored). Empty text returns usage and appends nothing. This is the only user-triggered write and the only slash command.

L04 Out of scope and forbidden: any HTTP call; dope-memory `POST /tools/memory_store` (not idempotent, unauthenticated, no summary redaction: NO_GO); ConPort in any form; `decision.logged`; the recap. The README lists each as NOT_BUILT with W01's blocker.

L05 Tests mock process.run (no real subprocess): exit 0, non-zero, timeout, `$.process` absent, order of mark-after-exit-0, the 3-per-tick cap, serial execution under a slow mock, the dead-row path, the exact argv, idempotent resend of the same event_id, `bridge-note` redaction and cap and empty input, no http.fetch anywhere, and that only task.completed and manual.memory_store are ever emitted.
